_doc: Crosswalk: Vietnamese indicator (TT96 / SSC-IFC) -> GRI Standards code(s).
Consumed by src/step05c_link_standard_indicators.py to mint StandardIndicator(GRI) nodes
CURATED, HUMAN-REVIEWED DATA. It lives in config/ (NOT in kpi_definitions_construction.json,
which kpi_build/ overwrites in place). step05c only emits an equivalentTo edge for rows whose
`status` == 'confirmed'. Rows in `needs_review` are ignored until a human moves them up and
DRAFT by Claude 2026-07-20 from the standard GRI topic families. A human MUST verify each row
against the SSC-IFC 'Environmental & Social Disclosure' handbook before flipping it to
confirmed — the GRI code granularity (e.g. 305-1 Scope 1 vs 305-2 Scope 2) matters for how
step07 later reasons about a claim on that indicator.

confirmed.gri_name: Direct (Scope 1) and energy indirect (Scope 2) GHG emissions
confirmed.note: Scope 1+2 GHG is the canonical GRI 305-1/305-2 pair.

confirmed.gri_name: Materials used by weight or volume
Reduction of energy consumption / renewable energy initiatives
confirmed.note: Renewable-energy result maps loosely; GRI has no dedicated renewable-share code.
TT96 says 'nước sử dụng' (use); GRI 303-3 is withdrawal, 303-5 is consumption. Confirm which.
GRI 2018 folded the old G4 EN10 recycled-water metric into 303 disclosures; verify code.

confirmed.gri_name: Compliance with laws and regulations (non-compliance incidents)
confirmed.note: Environmental-penalty COUNT. Old GRI 307-1 was retired into GRI 2-27 (2021).
Monetary value of environmental fines; same 2-27 lineage as 6.5.1.
Headcount = GRI 2-7; average-wage aspect leans GRI 405-2. Split may be needed.
TT96 bundles safety+health+welfare; GRI splits across 403-* and 401-2. Confirm.

confirmed.gri_name: Average hours of training per year per employee
confirmed.note: TT96-6.6.3 is 'share trained'; the hours metric is really 6.6.4 → 404-1. Verify split.

confirmed.gri_name: Average hours of training per year per employee
Operations with local community engagement programs
Direct economic value distributed — community investment
confirmed.note: Community CONTRIBUTION value; 201-1 is the closest economic-value code.
SSC-IFC E2 overlaps TT96-6.1.1; consider linking the two VN indicators too.

confirmed.gri_name: Diversity of governance bodies and employees

needs_review.why: Huy động vốn xanh (green financing) has no single stable GRI code; GRI 201 touches economic value but not green-bond issuance specifically.
Non-fired building materials ratio is a Vietnam construction-sector rule; no GRI equivalent.
Building energy-efficiency compliance is adjacent to energy use but is a code-compliance %, not a consumption figure.
Overlaps TT96-6.3.2; decide whether to map SSC-IFC energy-saving separately or alias it to the TT96 node.
